items.title: File Widerspruch against the Bescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 20.11.2026, sent by post. The letter states delivery is deemed to occur on the fourth day after posting, but the actual rule in § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X is the third day after posting (the letter's statement of the rule appears incorrect). Applying the correct statutory rule: day of posting = 20.11.2026 (day 0); day 1 = 21.11. (Sat); day 2 = 22.11. (Sun); day 3 = 23.11.2026 (Mon) = deemed bekanntgegeben, since 23.11. is itself a working day no further shift is needed. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period begins the next day, 24.11.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same calendar number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so § 193 BGB does not shift the date. Final due date: 23.12.2026.

warnings: The letter states that a postal Bescheid is deemed delivered on the "vierten Tag" (fourth day) after posting, but § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X actually provides for the third day after posting; I used the legally correct three-day rule to compute the Widerspruch deadline — if the actual mailing date differs from the letter's own date, re-check and adjust accordingly.
